item.title: Victoria Day Fireworks
item.description:
Date: Monday May 20th, Dusk (9:15pm) Location: Phin Park

Our annual amazing display of pyrotechnics in the park!!!

Bring the family and enjoy a big display put on by Pocket neighbours in Phin Park. All we ask is that you donate a bit of cash before or during so we can put on a spectacular show. People will come door to door and also be passing a bucket on the night to help cover costs. The show usually lasts over half an hour.

item.title: 6th Annual Pocket Food Drive
item.description:
Please donate to Eastview Neighbourhood Community Centre’s Food Bank. We want to get 500 items! Check out the bulletin board in Phin Park to keep track of our progress.

Donations will be accepted at 68 Seymour Ave. from Dec.1-15.

item.title: Phin Park Clean Up
item.description:
Date: Saturday April 23rd, 10am - noon Location: Phin Park

It's almost time for out annual spring clean up at the park!

Come on out with a shovel or rake or wheelbarrow and help tidy up our hood. There will be baked goods and coffee to keep you energized and Paula's office will make sure there is compost as well! Fire Truck as usual.

item.title: Friends of Phin Meeting
item.description:
Location: 87 Ravina Crescent Date: Monday, February 22nd at 7pm

We want your input!!!

Please come by and give us your ideas about how Phin Park can be improved and maintained as the Pocket's playground.

We are looking to pick your brains but also use some of your brawn to make things happen. This meeting with help us decide how to move forward with some exciting ideas but also what our small park can accommodate.

item.title: Pocket Skating Party
item.description:
Location: Phin Park Date: Sunday, February 18th from 12-3pm

  • 12-3pm Skating

    • Update: The Pocket Skating Party has been moved from Monday to Sunday due to weather conditions!

    On Family Day Monday, bring your skates, your best buds and join us for the Pocket Skating Party. Music, Food and a place to warm up after a frolic on the ice.

item.title: Safety Committee - Pedestrian Update 2016
item.description:
Hi Pocket People

The Pocket Community Association and its Safety Committee will be proposing to Councillor Paula Fletcher to move ahead with a number of initiatives to improve the walkability of our neighborhood and the safety of pedestrians, our kids and cyclists.

item.title: How do you use Recreation facilities? Give feedback for important Recreation plannin
item.description:
Parks, Forestry & Recreation is engaging in an important exercise to develop a Facilities Master Plan, to help guide investment in parks and recreation facilities for the next 20 years.

This is your chance to say what programs and services are important to you and our community. If you would, please take a few minutes and participate in the first online survey (posted here).
